objective: The id of a piece and of a failure class is kebab-case: lower case letters and digits, words joined by a single hyphen.

criteria.text: Only lower case words joined by single hyphens are accepted
Spaces, upper case, accents and edge hyphens are refused

fails: a name with a space or an upper case letter accepted; a regression
env: Node 24 and the standard library; the proof runs with node --test in a copy of this folder
output: the verdict of the critic on the issue
